source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
This fight type is open to a unit that is either:

- **[unengaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)**
- or was [unengaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) when the Fight step began and has since become **[engaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** in this phase

The unit may make 1 extra **[Pile-in move](vsdata:core-rule/pile-in-move)** and then fights following [Making Attacks](vsdata:core-rule/making-attacks) (04). It must also be **eligible to fight** in the [Fight Step](vsdata:core-rule/fight-step).

faq.question: may a unit eligible for Overrun Fight be selected for it when not also eligible to fight
faq.note: a unit that becomes engaged after the step starts and then unengaged again, and is no longer eligible to fight, cannot make an Overrun Fight
